shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then cat ../round-brief.md; else printf 'NO ROUND BRIEF\\n'; fi"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "afterModelResponse|UsageMetadata|receives collected response text and usage" src specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '45,85p' src/index.ts; sed -n '1,70p' src/orchestration/index.ts; sed -n '220,265p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; rg -n 'specs/.+#[0-9]+' .lore scripts src | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'OrchestratorHooks|chatOrchestrator' src/index.ts src/config.ts src/orchestration/index.ts; rg -n 'specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#|specs/hal-engine-config-hooks' .lore scripts src | head -40"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#[0-9]+|VALIDATED_BY|spec anchor'"' .lore scripts | head -90; sed -n '1,35p' src/index.ts; sed -n '1,100p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsageRound.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/index.ts src/index.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "reports total usage from a tool round|reports the summed usage from every provider" src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsageRound.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts; git diff --check; git status --short; git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/index.ts src/orchestration/index.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsageRound.test.ts && git commit -m "Sum provider usage across tool rounds"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main'
